body: Microsoft has withdrawn from Nscale's planned AI data center in Essex. Nscale told the BBC it still intends to go ahead with the project.
The pullback comes during a jittery stretch for AI infrastructure finance, with borrowing costs for some data-center builders climbing sharply and AI stocks selling off last week.
dek: Nscale says it will still build the Essex site without its anchor customer.
title: Microsoft walks away from a planned UK AI data center
